gmdn.gmdnPTDefinition: A flexible, non-steerable tube with an ultrasound imaging transducer enclosed in a fluid-resistant or waterproof acoustically- and electrically-insulated housing, designed for insertion into the vascular system (i.e., peripheral vascular system, coronary artery) by an operator; it is not intended for intracardial insertion/imaging. Also known as a vascular ultrasound transducer, it includes a single or an array of transducer element(s). This is a previously used single-use device that has been processed for an additional single-use patient application.
